selection.rule: First 100 currently held source ordinals after excluding both earlier first/second 100-row screens and eight repeated-owner rows under separate review

editorialGuardrails: A one-time comparison recommendation applies to the full source target only; it does not silently exclude a separately teachable core.
Conditional same-sense links are not approved aliases until the earlier owner is selected and checked.
Ordinary or compositional wording is not excluded merely for being non-idiomatic.
No source sentence is corrected silently; awkward form and mismatched sense stay held.
